User.title: User
User.description: User profile containing authentication identity, role, and profile photo URL

name.description: Full display name of the user

role.description: Role of the user (ADMIN, INSPECTOR, VIEWER)

photoUrl.description: Firebase Storage download URL for the user's profile photo

avatarUrl.description: Alternative key for profile photo URL

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the profile update

/users/{userId}.description: User documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Each user can access and update their own document.
